learning.title: Artifact names must be unique per attempt or a retried attempt gets 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED
learning.trigger: A worker step publishes an artifact and the step can be claimed again after a lease loss or restart.
learning.mistake: Artifact names are unique per task, type and name, and a second version of an existing name needs a parent version. A reclaimed attempt that republished the same name hit 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED.
learning.rule: Derive each attempt's artifact name from stable attempt identity, for example task-brief-<jobId>-<fence>.json, so a retry publishes a fresh name without a parent. Do not hide the 428 by adding a parent the attempt never read.

verification.requirement: A forced restart mid-step completes once, and the task lists one artifact per attempt with distinct names.
